📋 Diwira Travel — Airport Transfer Terms & Conditions

Last updated: September 2025  |  PT. Diwira Wisata Indonesia

1. Booking & Confirmation

All booking requests are submitted via WhatsApp and are considered tentative until confirmed in writing by our operations team. A booking is only confirmed after you receive an explicit confirmation message from Diwira Travel. We reserve the right to decline a request if the requested vehicle or route is unavailable on the selected date.

2. Pricing & Payment

The price shown during checkout is an estimate based on the distance you entered. The final price will be confirmed by our team via WhatsApp before your trip begins. No payment is collected online — payment is made directly to the driver on the day of service, in cash (IDR or USD accepted). Prices are all-inclusive with no hidden fees for the agreed route.

⚠️ Price estimates are calculated using driving distance. Actual fare may differ slightly if traffic diversion or a route change is agreed on the day.

3. Cancellation Policy

  • More than 24 hours before pickup: Full cancellation, no charge.
  • 12–24 hours before pickup: Cancellation accepted, a $5 administrative fee may apply.
  • Less than 12 hours before pickup: 50% of the agreed fare is payable as a late-cancellation fee.
  • No-show: If the passenger does not appear within the driver waiting time and cannot be reached, the full fare is payable.

4. Flight Delays & Changes

For arrival transfers, our driver monitors your flight and adjusts pickup time automatically for delays at no extra charge. Please notify us via WhatsApp if your flight is cancelled or rerouted. For departure transfers, the departure time is fixed — please allow sufficient time for traffic in Bali, especially on the Kuta–Seminyak–Nusa Dua corridor during peak hours.

5. Driver Waiting Time

  • Airport arrivals: Driver will wait up to 60 minutes from the actual landing time at no extra charge.
  • Hotel / villa pickups: Driver will wait up to 15 minutes from the agreed pickup time.
  • Waiting beyond these periods may incur an additional charge of $3 per 15 minutes, to be agreed with the driver.

6. Passenger & Luggage Limits

Standard vehicles (sedan/MPV) accommodate up to 5 passengers with standard luggage (1 suitcase + 1 carry-on per person). Requests exceeding this will require a larger vehicle (minibus) and will be subject to a custom quote. Oversized items (surfboards, bicycles, wheelchair equipment) must be declared at booking — additional charges may apply.

7. Child & Infant Policy

Children are counted as passengers for pricing purposes. If a child safety seat is required, please request one at booking — we will do our best to provide one, subject to availability. Infant seats may not be available on all vehicles. Diwira Travel complies with Indonesian road safety regulations.

8. Passenger Responsibility

Passengers are responsible for ensuring they have the correct documents (passport, visa, travel insurance) for entry into Indonesia. Diwira Travel is not liable for missed flights, connections, or border issues caused by passenger delays. Passengers must behave respectfully toward drivers. Diwira Travel reserves the right to refuse service to passengers who are intoxicated, abusive, or in violation of Indonesian law.

9. Liability

Diwira Travel operates fully licensed and insured vehicles in accordance with Indonesian transport regulations. Our liability in the event of a vehicle incident is limited to the terms of our operating insurance. We are not responsible for loss or damage to passenger belongings unless caused by proven negligence of the driver. We strongly recommend passengers carry their own travel insurance covering baggage loss and personal liability.

We recommend all international travelers carry comprehensive travel insurance that includes trip cancellation, medical evacuation, and personal liability cover.

10. Privacy & Data

Your personal information (name, email, phone number, flight details) is collected solely for the purpose of coordinating your transfer. We do not sell or share your data with third parties. Your WhatsApp contact may be used for booking coordination and, with your permission, for service updates from Diwira Travel. Data is stored in accordance with applicable Indonesian privacy regulations.

11. Governing Law

These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Any disputes arising from a booking shall be resolved first through good-faith discussion. If unresolved, disputes shall be referred to the courts of Tabanan Regency, Bali, Indonesia.

12. Contact

For any questions regarding these terms, please contact us:
📞 WhatsApp: +62 821 4724 2621
📧 Email: info.diwira@gmail.com

✦ Simple & transparent

Booking your Bali trip
takes four easy steps

No hidden fees. No confusion. Just tell us what you want and we'll handle the rest — like a neighbour who happens to know every corner of this island.

01
🗺️
Choose Your Package or Vehicle
Pick from our curated tour packages, or rent one of our well-maintained vehicles — from SUVs to comfortable minibuses — for a custom itinerary you plan yourself.
02
📅
Pick a Date & Group Size
Let us know your travel date and how many people are joining. We'll confirm availability within 2 hours — usually much faster during daytime hours.
03
💳
Fill Details & Pay DP
Share your name, WhatsApp number, and hotel address. A 30% deposit secures your booking — the rest is paid to the guide on the day. Bank transfer or GoPay/OVO accepted.
04
✅
Automatic Confirmation
You'll receive a booking confirmation via WhatsApp with your driver's name, contact number, and pickup time — usually within the hour. Then just enjoy Bali.
